A Fighter starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches (x2)** — item IDs `2, 15, 17, 23`.

Defined in `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65`, which maps class → item IDs; item names/details come from the `items` table rows in `worker/src/db/seed.sql`. Note: item `23` is actually Torches despite a code comment calling it Rations (tracked as bug B-09).
